strongest_attack: Strongest attack: challenge the load-bearing smoothness/pure-dimension input (Lemma 1.2 / FND-0159) by arguing that the FULL fixed-target Hurwitz stack, rather than only its simply-branched open, could be singular or have varying tangent dimension at wildly/highly ramified covers, which would collapse every downstream dimension count (18 for H, 16-2h for H^{comp,h}, the codimension-4 conclusion). Outcome: the attack FAILS. In characteristic zero d(psi):T_C->psi^*T_Y is a nonzero map of line bundles, hence injective, so the deformation complex [T_C->psi^*T_Y] is quasi-isomorphic to the torsion normal sheaf N_psi. Its length is deg(psi^*T_Y)-deg(T_C)=d(2-2h)+2g-2, which by Riemann-Hurwitz equals deg(R) and is determined solely by (d,g,h) - independent of the ramification profile - while H^1(N_psi)=0 for a torsion sheaf on a curve. Thus tangent dimension is constant (18) and obstructions vanish at every point, giving smoothness of pure dimension across all ramification types. This is precisely the ramification-profile-independent route that avoids the blocked branch-point-count inference. Secondary attacks also failed: (i) the openness of H^bal via h^0(F_t(-5))=5-a (balanced iff a=4, and h^0>=1 always since a<=4) correctly isolates the balanced locus as the open {h^0<=1}; (ii) the composed-locus bound needs only dim(image)<=dim(source), so it survives even if quasi-finiteness of c_h is dropped; (iii) Section 4's discriminant bound is declared redundant, so the theorem stands without it. No stack-vs-coarse, rational-vs-integral, cohomology-vs-Borel-Moore, Tate-twist, Gysin/Kunneth, spectral-sequence, invariants-vs-coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted-motive, or stable-pair attack applies: the theorem is a pure geometry lemma that explicitly disclaims all Hodge/weight/Tate/Borel-Moore/coarse/integral content and states clause (E) only over schemes (respecting FND-0144). theorem_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Let H = H_{4,6}(P^1) denote the moduli stack over k of pairs (C,gamma) with C a smooth projective connected curve of genus six and gamma : C -> P^1 a finite morphism of degree four onto a FIXED P^1, morphisms being isomorphisms of C commuting with gamma; equivalently, H is the open substack of the Kontsevich stack Mbar_{6,0}(P^1,4) whose source curve is smooth. Every gamma in H is finite flat Gorenstein, hence (imported source input, see Section 0) carries the Casnati-Ekedahl data: gamma_*O_C = O direct-sum E^vee with E locally free of rank three and degree nine; the relative-canonical embedding i : C -> X = P(E^vee) with p : X -> P^1, p_*O_X(1) = E and (N) in strong form i^*O_X(1) = omega_{C/P^1} = omega_C tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(2); and (CE) the two-term ideal resolution 0 -> O_X(-4) tensor p^*det F -> O_X(-2) tensor p^*F -> I_C -> 0 with F locally free of rank two. Throughout, F is taken in the packet orientation F = p_*(I_C(2)) = ker(Sym^2 E -> gamma_*(omega_{C/P^1}^{tensor 2})), of rank two and degree +9, and W := i^*(O_X(2) tensor p^*F^vee), W_f := (O_X(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-f))|_C, D := gamma^*O_{P^1}(1), L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} (FND-0156 convention discipline). Let H^bal be the locus where F is isomorphic to O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5); for h in {0,1,2,3} let H^{comp,h} be the locus of gamma admitting a factorization gamma = q o psi with psi : C -> Y and q : Y -> P^1 finite of degree two and Y a smooth projective connected curve of genus h, and H^comp the union of the H^{comp,h}; let H^ii be the type-(ii) locus of FND-0153 inside H^bal (phi_L : C -> P^2 = P(H^0(L)^vee) finite of degree two onto a smooth plane cubic) and H^i = H^bal minus H^ii its type-(i) complement. THEN: (A) H is a Deligne-Mumford stack of finite type over k, smooth over k of pure dimension 18, and more generally, for Y a fixed smooth projective connected curve of genus h, the stack of finite degree-d covers of Y by smooth projective connected genus-g curves is smooth of pure dimension 2g-2+d(2-2h); H^bal is OPEN in H, hence smooth over k of pure dimension 18, in particular reduced and normal, and every nonempty connected component of H^bal has dimension exactly 18. (B) Every nontrivial factorization of a gamma in H has both steps of degree two and intermediate genus h in {0,1,2,3}; H^{comp,h} is a constructible subset of |H| with dim H^{comp,h} <= 16-2h, so in particular dim H^{comp,1} <= 14 and dim H^comp <= 16. Independently of that count, the discriminant morphism br : H -> |O_{P^1}(18)| = P^18 sending gamma to its branch divisor Br(gamma) = sum_p (e_p - 1) gamma(p) of degree 18 is quasi-finite, so the non-simply-branched locus br^{-1}(Delta_18) (Delta_18 the non-reduced-divisor hypersurface, closed irreducible of dimension 17) is closed of dimension at most 17 and contains H^comp by FND-0158(a). (C) H^bal intersect H^{comp,0} is empty and H^ii is contained in H^{comp,1}; consequently dim H^ii <= 14 and the entire non-primitive locus H^bal intersect H^comp has dimension at most 14, i.e. codimension at least four in H^bal. (D) Therefore NO connected component of H^bal is contained in H^ii: every nonempty connected component of H^bal contains a type-(i) point, the closure of H^ii in H^bal is closed of dimension at most 14, and H^i contains the dense open substack H^bal minus that closure, of complement codimension at least four. Since H^bal is nonempty (FND-0154), the balanced type-(i) locus is nonempty and dense in every connected component. The same statements hold verbatim for the PGL_2-quotient Hbar^bal = [H^bal / PGL_2], which is smooth of pure dimension 15, whose connected components correspond bijectively to those of H^bal (PGL_2 being connected) and in which the non-primitive locus has dimension at most 11, again codimension at least four. (E) Consequently the type-(i) hypothesis of FND-0155 is automatic on the universal balanced family. Precisely: let V be a k-scheme locally of finite type with a smooth surjective morphism V -> H^bal (a smooth atlas), or more generally let S be a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme carrying a genus-six degree-four family with target P^1_S satisfying (CE)+(N)+(BAL), such that no connected component of S has classifying image contained in H^ii - which holds in particular whenever that image has dimension at least 15. Let S_beta be any connected component, U_beta the distinct-support (reduced-support) open of the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle P_{S_beta}(pi_*L) (available by ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8, the base being reduced; equal to the CE evaluation-failure model by ATT-0065/CLM-0065-9 and ATT-0066/CLM-0066-5, CLM-0066-6), and Z_beta = Ord(U_beta) -> U_beta the finite etale right S_6-torsor of orderings of the universal degree-six divisor. Then U_beta is connected, the monodromy image H_beta = im(pi_1^et(U_beta) -> S_6) equals S_6, the orbit set H_beta \ S_6 of left multiplication (the set of right cosets H_beta g, with component stabilizer g^{-1} H_beta g in the FND-0151 normalization) is a singleton, Z_beta is connected and finite etale of degree 720 over U_beta, and whenever U_beta is in addition normal, integral and locally Noetherian - which holds for every connected component of a smooth atlas - Z_beta is irreducible with stabilizer S_6; the FND-0152 induction functor Ind_{H_beta}^{S_6} is then the identity, so that F(Z_beta)^{S_6} = F(U_beta) for every additive S_6-equivariant functor F to Q-vector spaces or mixed Q-Hodge structures. NOT ASSERTED: any Hodge, weight, purity, Tate, Borel-Moore or RED-0001 conclusion (FND-0053 and FND-0152(ii) stand); any statement over algebraic stacks with inertia (FND-0144 stands), over nonreduced bases, with integral coefficients, or on coarse moduli (FND-0075 stands); any statement about M_{6,6}, its forgetful map, Aut(C,Gamma), closedness, purity, Gysin maps or codimension in M_{6,6}; the number of connected components of H^bal or its irreducibility; existence of balanced non-primitive covers with intermediate genus two or three; the H_alpha object F(Z_alpha^1) as an H_alpha-object.
